passages.text: Mandevilla splendens, the shining mandevilla, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is an evergreen vine, native to Brazil.

It climbs by twining and can grow to {{convert|3 |m|ft|abbr=on}} high. It has wide green glossy leaves of elliptical or rectangular shape growing to {{convert| 20|cm|in|abbr=on}} long. The flowers are rose-pink with yellow centers, appearing from late spring to early summer. They are up to {{convert|10 |cm|in|abbr=on}} in length. It prefers temperatures remaining over {{convert|5-10 |C|F|abbr=on}}. In temperate zones it can be placed outside during the summer months, but must have protection in winter. It requires a sheltered spot in full sun. It has gained the Royal Horticultural Society's Award of Garden Merit.
